# VL.Avalonia Unit-Test Candidates & Code Review Report

This report surveys `VL.Avalonia`, `VL.Avalonia.CodeGen`, `VL.Avalonia.Custom`, `VL.Avalonia.Skia`, and `VL.Avalonia.Stride` (wrapping Avalonia 11.2.1 for vvvv/VL) to identify high-value unit-test candidates covering custom library logic rather than Avalonia's own property/control behaviour. Across 289 project and source files, we identified **20 concrete test candidates** spanning reactive `IChannel<T>` bindings, Roslyn incremental code generation, VL template regions and `TreeDataTemplate` child reconciliation, routed/standard event lifecycles, immutable style graphs, CSS selector parsing, Skia host input/DPI/multi-touch translation, control reparenting, attached-property sanitization, and math/color/animation conversions—alongside **21 high- and medium-confidence bugs** discovered during inspection. Most candidates (13 of 20) can run as fast, platform-free `Unit` tests (`AvaloniaObject`/`AvaloniaProperty` and `Channel<T>` work without a windowing backend), 6 require `Avalonia.Headless` (logical/visual tree realization, routed-event bubbling, `Application`/XAML loading, or template parts), and 1 uses Roslyn's `CSharpGeneratorDriver` (`Generator`).

---

## Already covered

The following files already have tests implemented or planned and are excluded from the proposals below:

- `VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\ItemsReconciler.cs` — in-place diff/reconciliation of an `AvaloniaList<T>` against a new `IReadOnlyList<T>`.
- `VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\ItemsSourceSync.cs` — synchronization from `IChannel<IReadOnlyList<T>>` or `Spread<T>` to `ItemsControl.ItemsSource` via a persistent `AvaloniaList<T>`.

## Detailed Candidates (Ordered by Priority)

### 1. Core Reactive Channel–Property Binding Engine (`BindingHelpers`, `BindingNode`, `BindingNameNode`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Unit`
- **What it does:** `BindingHelpers.Bind` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\BindingHelpers.cs:20-264`) and its `BindingNode` / `BindingNameNode` wrappers (`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\BindingNode.cs:11-165`, `VL.Avalonia\src\Data\BindingNameNode.cs:11-80`) bridge `IChannel<TValue>` and `AvaloniaProperty` across `OneWay`, `TwoWay`, `OneTime`, `OneWayToSource`, and `Default` modes with `BindingPriority`, `SupprotedBindingInitialValueHandling`, converter callbacks, and re-entrancy (`isBusy`) protection. `TryConvertValue` (`BindingHelpers.cs:270-352`) adapts channel/property values using custom converters, `DefaultValueConverter.Instance`, or `AvaloniaProperty.UnsetValue` / `BindingNotification(BindingErrorType.Error)`.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - `BindingMode.Default` resolution (`BindingHelpers.cs:54-56`): resolves to `TwoWay` when `property.GetMetadata(target.GetType()).DefaultBindingMode` is `TwoWay` (e.g., `TextBox.TextProperty`) and `OneWay` otherwise (e.g., `TextBlock.TextProperty`).
  - `OneTime` initial handoff (`BindingHelpers.cs:108-117`): `ChannelToControl` writes `channel.Value` once and returns `Disposable.Empty` (subsequent channel or control mutations do not propagate); `ControlToChannel` copies `target.GetValue(property)` into `channel`.
  - Suspicious `SupprotedBindingInitialValueHandling.None` (`BindingNode.cs:17`, `BindingHelpers.cs:111-141`): verify current behaviour where `None` is ignored—`OneTime` falls into `else PushToProperty()`, and `OneWay`/`TwoWay` still `.StartWith(channel.Value)`, overwriting the control's initial value.
  - `ControlToChannel` in `TwoWay` mode (`BindingHelpers.cs:129-142`): copies control value to channel first, then binds `source` with `.StartWith(channel.Value)` at `BindingPriority.LocalValue`—verify round-trip fidelity and whether lossy converters cause a value shift on initial bind.
  - Converter failure isolation (`BindingHelpers.cs:66-93, 270-352`): throwing converter in `ToPropertyObject` returns `new BindingNotification(ex, BindingErrorType.Error)` without crashing; throwing converter in `PushToChannel` leaves channel untouched; `null` for non-nullable value-type `StyledProperty<int>` returns `AvaloniaProperty.UnsetValue` rather than `0`, whereas for `DirectProperty` (`IsDirect == true`, line 292) it falls through to `0`.
  - Feedback-loop / re-entrancy suppression (`BindingHelpers.cs:72-105, 138`): mutating `channel.Value` in `TwoWay` mode updates property once without ping-ponging, and frame-by-frame identical channel pushes are filtered by `.DistinctUntilChanged()`.
  - Suspicious `BindingNameAdvancedNode` stale `_property` bug (`BindingNameNode.cs:28-65`): bind `"Text"` on a `TextBox`, then call `SetInput(new Border())` or `SetProperty("NonExistent")` or `SetProperty(null)`—`ResolveProperty()` returns `false` without clearing `_property`, leaving `TextBox.TextProperty` bound onto `Border` or keeping the old subscription active.
- **Test seam needed:** None (`VL.Avalonia.csproj:29` already declares `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="VL.Avalonia.Tests" />`, and `BindingHelpers`, `BindingNode`, `BindingNameNode` are `public`). Plain `AvaloniaObject` subclasses or `TextBox`/`Border` instances work without `Avalonia.Headless`.

### 2. Typed Node Bindings & Commands (`TwoWayBinding`, `OneWayBinding`, `CommandBinding`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Unit`
- **What it does:** `TwoWayBinding<TValue, TProperty>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\TwoWayBinding.cs:7-86`), `OneWayBinding<TValue, TProperty>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\OneWayBinding.cs:13-66`), and `CommandBinding` / `UnitCommandBinding` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\CommandBinding.cs:10-90`) are the standard per-pin reactive helpers embedded inside almost all control wrappers (`Slider`, `TextBox`, `CheckBox`, `ComboBox`, `Button`, `ScrollViewer`, `MenuItem`, etc.).
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - `TwoWayBinding.Bind` initial priority (`TwoWayBinding.cs:49-71`): skips initial control emission (`.Skip(1)`) and `.StartWith(channel.Value)` so channel wins on attach via `SetCurrentValue`, while subsequent control changes push back through `channel.EnsureValue(value)`.
  - Rebinding and disposal (`TwoWayBinding.cs:39-79`, `OneWayBinding.cs:39-64`): calling `Bind` with the same `IChannel` reference is a no-op; calling `Bind` with a second channel disposes the first subscription so mutations on channel 1 no longer touch the control; `Bind(null)` and `Dispose()` detach cleanly.
  - `OneWayBinding` read-only direction (`OneWayBinding.cs:47-55`): immediately pushes current control property value on `Bind` (`GetObservable` initial replay) and updates channel on control changes, while external writes to `channel` do not write back to `_control`.
  - Suspicious `Nullable<T>` default converter crash (`TwoWayBinding.cs:28-37`, `OneWayBinding.cs:29-31`): instantiating `new TwoWayBinding<float?, double?>(control, prop)` without custom lambdas calls `Convert.ChangeType(1.5f, typeof(double?))`, which throws `InvalidCastException` because `Nullable<double>` does not implement `IConvertible`.
  - Culture invariance check (`TwoWayBinding.cs:31, 36`): under a comma-decimal `CurrentCulture` (e.g., `de-DE`), default `string` ↔ `double` conversion uses `Convert.ChangeType` without `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture`.
  - `CommandBinding.Execute` & `UnitCommandBinding` (`CommandBinding.cs:29-56, 70-89`): `Bind(channel)` assigns `_control.SetValue(_commandProperty, this)`; `Execute(param)` pushes typed `T` (or `default!` when `parameter is not T`) to channel; `Bind(null)` or `Dispose()` calls `_control.ClearValue(_commandProperty)` and stops forwarding `Execute`.
- **Test seam needed:** None (`public` classes; `Channel.Create<T>()` from `VL.Lib.Reactive` and a minimal `AvaloniaObject` test double with `StyledProperty` suffice).

### 3. `[ImplementProperty]` & RoutedEvent Source Generators (`VL.Avalonia.CodeGen`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Generator`
- **What it does:** `AvaloniaSourceGenerator` (`VL.Avalonia.CodeGen\AvaloniaSourceGenerator.cs:12-120`) is an `IIncrementalGenerator` that scans `partial` `[ProcessNode]` classes (`ProcessNodeHandler.cs:9-79`) for fields annotated with `[ImplementProperty]` (`PropertyAttributeHandler.cs:11-253`) and emits `Set<Prop>(Optional<T>)` fragment methods with optional converters, nullable casts, pin visibility/order, and inherited Avalonia XML docs. `AvaloniaReflectionGenerator` (`AvaloniaReflectionGenerator.cs:8-33`) runs `RoutedEventGenerator` (`Forwards\RoutedEventGenerator.cs:12-254`) and `RoutedEventArgsGenerator` (`Forwards\RoutedEventArgsGenerator.cs:11-104`) to scan referenced `Avalonia.*` assemblies and emit `*EventListener` nodes and `[assembly: ImportType]` forwards.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - String vs `typeof` constructor forms (`PropertyAttributeHandler.cs:27-46, 133-147`): `[ImplementProperty("Control.TagProperty")]` vs `[ImplementProperty(typeof(Control), nameof(Control.TagProperty))]` vs generic `[ImplementProperty<float, double>(...)]` emit valid C# that compiles with zero diagnostics.
  - Value converter and nullable-return converter branches (`PropertyAttributeHandler.cs:48-63, 212-235`): `Converter = nameof(ConvertFn)` where `ConvertFn` returns `double` vs `double?` (e.g., `FlexValueHelper`) emits the `__converted.HasValue` branch vs direct `_output.SetValue` / `ClearValue`.
  - Base-class converter lookup (`PropertyAttributeHandler.cs:50-58`): converter method declared on an abstract generic base class rather than the derived partial class is still discovered and nullable-checked.
  - Generic class declarations (`ProcessNodeHandler.cs:25-78`): preserves generic type parameters (`<TControl, TValue>`) and `where` constraints on generated `partial class`.
  - Suspicious hint-name collision (`AvaloniaSourceGenerator.cs:113-115`): two partial classes named `Foo<T>` and `Foo<T1, T2>` (or `Foo` in two namespaces) both call `context.AddSource("Foo.g.cs", ...)`, triggering Roslyn `ArgumentException` for duplicate `hintName`.
  - Suspicious attribute syntax matching (`ProcessNodeHandler.cs:15-20`, `AvaloniaSourceGenerator.cs:31-35`): `[VL.Core.Import.ProcessNode]` (namespace-qualified) fails `attr.Name.ToString().StartsWith("ProcessNode")` and silently skips code generation.
  - XML documentation extraction & sanitization (`PropertyAttributeHandler.cs:91-123, 148-209`): `<param>`, `<summary>`, and `<inheritdoc/>` auto-fetching `<see cref="P:Avalonia..."/>` tags strip XML tags and newlines without breaking C# comments; test malformed XML edge cases.
  - `RoutedEventGenerator` & `RoutedEventArgsGenerator` (`RoutedEventGenerator.cs:23-189`, `RoutedEventArgsGenerator.cs:20-76`): skips `[Obsolete]` types/fields, deduplicates `(ownerType, eventName)` pairs, maps `Field.Name` stripping `"Event"` suffix, and skips internal/obsolete `RoutedEventArgs` subclasses.
- **Test seam needed:** Reference `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp` in the test project and add a project reference (or `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="VL.Avalonia.Tests" />` in `VL.Avalonia.CodeGen\VL.Avalonia.CodeGen.csproj`) so `CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new AvaloniaSourceGenerator(), new AvaloniaReflectionGenerator())` can drive synthetic compilations referencing `Avalonia.Base`, `Avalonia.Controls`, and `VL.Core`.

### 4. Template Regions, `TreeDataTemplate`, & `ChildrenSource` Lifetime (`Controls\DataTemplate\*`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Headless`
- **What it does:** `TemplateRegionBase<TInlay, TItem>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\DataTemplate\TemplateRegionBase.cs:15-102`), `DataTemplateNode` (`DataTemplateNode.cs:14-106`), `TreeDataTemplateNodeBase<T, TChild>` (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:15-258`), and `DataTemplateSelectorNode` (`DataTemplateSelectorNode.cs:18-108`) implement VL's region-based `IDataTemplate` / `ITreeDataTemplate` system. Each materialized control owns a per-instance inlay (`Func<TInlay>`), disposes that inlay on `DetachedFromLogicalTree` or `Invalidate()`/`Dispose()`, and in `TreeDataTemplateNodeBase` manages per-item `ChildrenSource` observables (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:135-208`) keyed by data item.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - `Match(object? data)` (`DataTemplateNode.cs:40`, `TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:212`): returns `true` only when `data is T` (and `false` for `null` even when `T` is a reference type).
  - Build + detach lifecycle (`TemplateRegionBase.cs:26-49, 86-101`): building a control for item `x` invokes `inlayFactory` once; attaching the built control to a `StackPanel` or `ItemsControl` and then removing it fires `DetachedFromLogicalTree`, disposing the inlay exactly once and removing the instance from `_instances`.
  - Experimental per-frame `UpdateInstances()` vs standard `Update(invalidate)` (`DataTemplateNode.cs:76-106`, `TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:65-80, 234-258`): standard node runs inlay only on `Build` until `invalidate: true` clears `_instances` and increments `_version` (recreating `Template`); experimental node re-invokes `Update` on all live inlays every frame while keeping the original `Control` instance.
  - `TreeDataTemplateNodeBase.ChildrenSource` pass-through vs reconciled list (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:154-180`): when `children` implements `IList` and `INotifyCollectionChanged` (e.g., `AvaloniaList<TChild>`), `Push` forwards it directly and clears `_list`; when `children` is an immutable `Spread<TChild>`, `Push` reconciles `_list` in place via `ItemsReconciler.Sync` and skips `OnNext` on subsequent updates because `ReferenceEquals(current, Current)` stays true (mutations propagate via `_list.CollectionChanged`).
  - Reference-equality short-circuit (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:156-157`): passing the exact same `IReadOnlyList<TChild>` reference twice is a no-op; passing a newly allocated list with updated children updates `_list` in place.
  - `SelectItems` before `Build` and `DropIfIdle` cleanup (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:82-133, 182-207`): if Avalonia queries `ItemsSelector(item)` before `Build(item)` runs, `GetOrCreateSource` creates a `ChildrenSource` that replays `_list` on `Subscribe` and later receives children when `Build` calls `Push`; once both `Built <= 0` (detached) and all observers unsubscribe, `DropIfIdle` removes the key from `_childrenSources` (preventing memory leaks across collapsed/removed tree nodes).
  - Duplicate data items in a tree (`TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:43-63, 148-150`): two controls built for the same `item` increment `source.Built` to `2`; detaching one decrements `Built` to `1` and keeps `ChildrenSource` alive until the second control also detaches.
  - `DataTemplateSelectorNode` (`DataTemplateSelectorNode.cs:24-108`): first matching non-null template wins; `Fallback` used only when none match; `Holds` (`lines 58-69`) detects structural changes in `Spread<IDataTemplate?>` by reference equality; `ItemsSelector` (`lines 99-107`) delegates when the matched template is an `ITreeDataTemplate` and returns `null` otherwise.
- **Test seam needed:** Implement lightweight test doubles for `IDataTemplateInlay<T>` and `ITreeDataTemplateInlay<T, TChild>` (public interfaces at `DataTemplateNode.cs:9-12` and `TreeDataTemplateNode.cs:9-13`) and call `SetPatchInlayFactory` directly. `Avalonia.Headless` ensures `TreeView`/`ItemsControl` logical-tree attach/detach and `InstancedBinding` subscriptions behave identically to production.

### 5. Routed & Standard Event Listeners (`RoutedEventListener`, `StandardEventListenerBase`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Headless`
- **What it does:** `RoutedEventListener<TControl, TArgs>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Interactivity\RoutedEventListener.cs:14-137`), `RoutedEventListener<T>` (`lines 144-159`), and `RoutedEventListenerName<TArgs>` (`lines 166-208`) subscribe to Avalonia `RoutedEvent`s with configurable `RoutingStrategies` (`Direct`, `Bubble`, `Tunnel`) and `HandledEventsToo`, invoking a VL `Func<TControl, TArgs, bool>` callback that sets `args.Handled = true` when returning `true`. `StandardEventListenerBase<TControl, TArgs>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Interactivity\StandardEventListenerBase.cs:8-50`) manages standard CLR event subscriptions across input changes and disposal.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - Tunnel/Bubble/Direct routing & `Handled` propagation (`RoutedEventListener.cs:96-125`): raising a routed event on a child `Button` inside a `Border` invokes listener on `Border` during `Bubble`/`Tunnel`, sets `e.Handled = true` when `Handler` returns `true`, and only reaches a downstream listener if `handledEventsToo` is `true`.
  - Sender/args type filtering (`RoutedEventListener.cs:101-115`): if `args` is not `TArgs` or `sender` is not `TControl`, `Handler` is not called and no cast exception occurs.
  - Suspicious `Event` closure bug on `SetRoutedEvent` (`RoutedEventListener.cs:127-130, 151-158`): subscribe to `EventA` on `button`, then call `SetRoutedEvent(EventB)`—because `Event` is mutated *before* `_subscription.Disposable = Disposable.Empty` runs `target.RemoveHandler(Event, ...)`, `RemoveHandler` removes `EventB` instead of `EventA`, leaking `EventA`'s handler so raising `EventA` still fires!
  - Suspicious `ArgumentNullException` when clearing event (`RoutedEventListener.cs:129, 155-156, 177-184`): subscribe to `"Button.Click"` in `RoutedEventListenerName<RoutedEventArgs>`, then call `SetRoutedEvent(null)` or `SetRoutedEvent("NonExistent.Event")`—`Event` becomes `null`, and `_subscription` cleanup calls `target.RemoveHandler(null!, ...)`, throwing `ArgumentNullException`.
  - `"Owner.Name"` resolution (`RoutedEventListener.cs:188-207`): resolves `"Button.Click"` and `"Avalonia.Controls.Button.Click"` (`parts[^2]` and `parts[^1]`), returns `null` for `"Click"` (no dot) or whitespace, and verify ambiguity when two owners in different namespaces share `OwnerType.Name`.
  - `StandardEventListenerBase` target switching & disposal (`StandardEventListenerBase.cs:14-49`): switching `SetInput(control1)` → `SetInput(control2)` unsubscribes `control1` and subscribes `control2`; `Dispose()` unsubscribes `control2` and sets `_input = null`.
- **Test seam needed:** None (`RoutedEventListener<T>`, `RoutedEventListenerName<TArgs>`, and generated subclasses of `StandardEventListenerBase` are `public`). `Avalonia.Headless` provides visual/logical parent chains for tunnel/bubble routing.

### 6. Immutable Style Graph, Multi-Pin Style Setters, & Style Extensions (`Styles\*`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Unit`
- **What it does:** `ImmutableSetter<T>` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Styles\ImmutableStyle.cs:17-57`), `ImmutableSelector` (`ImmutableSelector.cs:6-34`), `StyleExtensions` (`StyleExtensions.cs:6-33`), and `StyleSetterBase.cs` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Styles\StyleSetterBase.cs:17-454`) build chained immutable VL style descriptors (`IAvaloniaStyle`) and materialize them into `Avalonia.Styling.Style` instances via `StyledElement.TryUpdateStyles` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Extensions\StyledElementExtensions.cs:29-46`).
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - Downstream-wins setter deduplication (`ImmutableStyle.cs:23-56`, `StyleExtensions.cs:8-32`): chaining upstream `SetBackground(Red)` → downstream `SetBackground(Blue)` builds a `Style` from outer (downstream) to inner (upstream), and `TryAddSetter` (`StyleExtensions.cs:24-25`) skips duplicate `AvaloniaProperty` entries so `Blue` wins and `style.Setters.Count == 1`.
  - Per-owner `Transitions` materialization (`ImmutableStyle.cs:29-49`): an `ImmutableSetter<Spread<IAvaloniaTransition>>` builds a fresh `Avalonia.Animation.Transitions` collection per `StyledElement` owner and resolves property names against `owner.GetType()`.
  - `ImmutableSelector` wrapping (`ImmutableSelector.cs:13-33`): wraps upstream setters inside a child `Style(x => Selector)` added to `parentStyle.Children`; when `Selector` is `null`, attaches child style without selector.

Same issue in `StyleSetterSRT` (`lines 150-171`, sets identity transform instead of `NoValue`), `StyleSetterThicknessLTRB`, `StyleSetterCornerRadiusTB`, and `StyleSetterCornerRadiusTLTRBRBL`.

### 7. Skia Host TopLevel Input Routing, DPI Scaling, & Multi-Touch (`GammaTopLevelImpl`, `AvaloniaLayer`)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Headless`
- **What it does:** `GammaTopLevelImpl` (`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:22-405`) and `AvaloniaLayer` (`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\AvaloniaLayer.cs:22-170`) implement Avalonia's `ITopLevelImpl` for vvvv's Skia renderer—translating VL mouse, keyboard, focus-lost, and multi-touch notifications into `RawInputEventArgs`, scaling client coordinates by DPI, compensating sub-viewport render offsets, and remapping recycled Stride touch IDs.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - DPI scaling & client-size recalculation (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:44-72`, `AvaloniaLayer.cs:91-111`): `SetClientSize(new Size(800, 600))` followed by `SetScaling(2.0f)` fires `ScalingChanged(2.0)` and `Resized(new Size(400, 300), ...)`; `SetScaling(0.0f)` throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`; test negative/`NaN` scaling edge cases.
  - Render-offset compensation (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:93-122, 385-390`, `AvaloniaLayer.cs:124-134`): when rendered at viewport `(100, 50)` with `CompensateRenderOffset = true` (default), `Notify` subtracts `(100, 50)` before dividing by `_scaling`; when `CompensateRenderOffset = false` or using `SendNotification`, custom/raw coordinates pass through without subtracting `_renderOffset`.
  - Suspicious XOR mouse button modifier bug (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:191-197`): sending `MouseUpNotification(MouseButtons.Left)` *without* a prior `MouseDownNotification` (e.g., drag started outside the layer and released inside) executes `_inputModifiers ^= LeftMouseButton`, **setting** `LeftMouseButton` to `1` on all subsequent mouse-move events!
  - Suspicious key/mouse modifier clobbering (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:257-260`): holding `MouseButtons.Left` (`_inputModifiers == LeftMouseButton`) and pressing `Keys.ShiftKey | Keys.Shift` executes `_inputModifiers = keyCode.KeyData.ToModifier()`, wiping out `LeftMouseButton` mid-drag.
  - Multi-touch session ID remapping & synthetic mouse suppression (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:158-159, 186-187, 307-361`): recycled Stride touch ID `0` across two sequential `TouchDown`→`TouchUp` gestures receives distinct `RawPointerId`s (`1`, then `2`); while `_activeTouchIds.Count > 0`, `MouseDownNotification` and `LostFocusNotification` are suppressed and `notification.Handled` is set to `true`.
  - Suspicious stuck touch state on `TouchCancel` (`GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:322-336`, `KeyUtils.cs:62-75`): if a touch ends with a kind mapped to `RawPointerEventType.TouchCancel` (anything other than `TouchDown`/`TouchUp`/`TouchMove`), `switch (notification.Kind)` hits `default:` without removing `notification.Id` from `_activeTouchIds`, permanently muting all mouse input for the rest of the session.
- **Test seam needed:** Add `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="VL.Avalonia.Tests" />` to `VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\VL.Avalonia.Skia.csproj` because `GammaTopLevelImpl` is `sealed class` (internal) and `Notify`/`SendNotification`/`HandleNotification` are `internal`. Use `Avalonia.Headless` (or `AvaloniaInitializer.Init()`) to obtain a valid `Compositor` and `EmbeddableControlRoot`.

### 9. Visual/Logical Control Reparenting & Runtime Warning Lifecycle (`ReparentingHelper` + Call Sites)
- **Priority:** High | **Harness:** `Headless`
- **What it does:** `ReparentingHelper.DetachFromParent` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\ReparentingHelper.cs:13-69`) is invoked whenever a `Control` is placed into a `Panel` (`PanelNodeBase.cs:37-40`), `ContentControl` (`ContentControlNodeBase.cs:36-38`), `Decorator` (`DecoratorNodeBase.cs:35-38`), or `ToolTip` (`ToolTip.cs:139-142`) to prevent Avalonia's `"Control already has a visual parent"` crash, while posting a 9-second auto-expiring persistent warning to `NodeContext`.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - Parent-type switch coverage (`ReparentingHelper.cs:27-49`): detaches `control` cleanly when its current `Parent` is a `Panel` (`StackPanel`), `ContentControl` (`Button`), `ContentPresenter`, `Decorator` (`Border`), `Viewbox`, or direct-items `ItemsControl`, leaving `control.Parent == null` so adding it to a new parent succeeds.
  - Non-matching `ContentControl` / `Decorator` guard (`ReparentingHelper.cs:32-42`): if `parent` is a `ContentControl` whose `Content` is no longer `control`, `Content` is not nulled out.
  - Unparented fast path (`ReparentingHelper.cs:23-25`): when `control.Parent is null`, returns immediately without calling `AddPersistentMessage`.
  - Suspicious crash when previous parent is an `ItemsControl` bound via `ItemsSource` (`ReparentingHelper.cs:44-46`): when `control` was placed inside an `ItemsControl` whose `ItemsSource` is set (e.g., via `ItemsSourceSync`), `itemsControl.Items.Remove(control)` throws `InvalidOperationException` because `ItemCollection` is read-only while `ItemsSource` is active!
  - Warning disposal (`ReparentingHelper.cs:54-68`): `EnqueueReparentWarning` calls `nodeContext.AddPersistentMessage(MessageSeverity.Warning, ...)` and disposes the returned `IDisposable` after `MessageLifetime` (verify behaviour with `NodeContext.Default` when running outside vvvv editor).
- **Test seam needed:** Make `MessageLifetime` configurable or `internal` (or extract a `TimeSpan` overload on `DetachFromParent`) so unit tests do not have to wait 9 real seconds to verify `message.Dispose()`. Pass `NodeContext.Default` in tests (`Avalonia.Headless` ensures `ContentPresenter` / visual-logical parent pointers match runtime).

### 14. Transform Decomposition, Angle Units, & Math/Color Conversions (`TransformOperationsHelper`, `ControlNodeBase.SetRenderTransform`, `ColorExtensions`, `MathExtensions`, `Effects`)
- **Priority:** Medium | **Harness:** `Unit`
- **What it does:** `TransformOperationsHelper` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\TransformOperationsHelper.cs:9-26`), `VisualNodeBase.SetRenderTransform` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Base\Control\ControlNodeBase.cs:162-183`), `SetRenderTransformAnimatable` (`Styles.cs:124-145`), `ColorExtensions` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Extensions\ColorExtensions.cs:8-36`), `MathExtensions` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Extensions\MathExtensions.cs:9-111`), and `DropShadowDirectionEffectWrapper` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Media\Effects.cs:78-103`) convert Stride/VL math types (`Matrix`, cycles `float`, `Color4`, `Vector2`, `RectangleF`) into Avalonia primitives.

Passing a 90° (`π/2` rad) Z-rotation matrix into `VisualNodeBase.SetRenderTransform` calls `MathUtil.RadiansToDegrees(roll)` (`90.0`) and passes `90.0` *radians* (~5156.6°) to `AppendRotate`, whereas `SetRenderTransformAnimatable` (`Styles.cs:135`) passes `roll` (`π/2` rad) directly!
  - `TransformSRT` cycle conversion (`TransformOperationsHelper.cs:11-25`): `rotation = 0.25f` (quarter turn in VL cycles) produces `π/2` radians (`AppendRotate(Math.PI / 2)`), `scale = (2, 3)` scales X/Y, `translation = (10, -20)` translates X/Y, and all-`NoValue` produces identity.
  - Suspicious infinite recursion in `ColorExtensions.ToColor(this Color? color)` (`ColorExtensions.cs:33-34`): calling `((Avalonia.Media.Color?)Colors.Red).ToColor()` calls `color.ToColor()` on `Color?` instead of `color.Value.ToColor()`, immediately crashing with **`StackOverflowException`**!
  - Out-of-range HDR `Color4` clamping (`ColorExtensions.cs:10-20`): passing `new Color4(1.5f, -0.2f, 0.5f, 1.0f)` into `ToColor()` performs unchecked `(byte)(channel * 255)` casts (`(byte)382 == 126`, `(byte)-51 == 205`) instead of clamping to `[0, 255]`.
  - Suspicious inverted `_direction.HasValue` check in `DropShadowDirectionEffectWrapper.SetDirection` (`Media\Effects.cs:83-101`): calling `SetDirection(0.25f)` on a fresh node checks `if (_direction.HasValue)` (which is `false` because `_direction` hasn't been assigned yet!), enters `else`, and calls `ClearValue` instead of setting `90.0`—and calling `SetDirection(0.25f)` on frame 2 hits `_direction != direction == false`, so `Direction` **can never be set on first connection**! Conversely, clearing `SetDirection(NoValue)` after a value was set enters `if (_direction.HasValue)` and sets `0.0` instead of calling `ClearValue`!
  - `MathExtensions` conversions (`MathExtensions.cs:11-110`): `FromRect`/`ToRect`, `ToThickness` uniform vs H/V vs L/T/R/B order, `ToCornerRadius`, and `ToRelativePoint`/`ToRelativeRect`.

- **Priority:** Medium | **Harness:** `Headless`
- **What it does:** `NumberField` (`VL.Avalonia.Custom\src\Controls\Value\NumberField.cs:9-171`) and `EditableSlider` (`VL.Avalonia.Custom\src\Controls\Value\EditableSlider.cs:8-132`) are custom templated controls supporting drag-to-scrub (`NumberField`) and middle-click-to-type inline editing (`IsEditing`) with `Enter` commit, `Escape` rollback, and `TopLevel` pointer-outside dismissal, styled via `ResourceLoader.IncludeCustomResources` (`VL.Avalonia.Custom\src\Resources\ResourceLoader.cs:9-52`).
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - `ResourceLoader.IncludeCustomResources` (`ResourceLoader.cs:13-51`): throws `ArgumentNullException` on `null` app; loads `Resources.axaml` and `Styles.axaml` into `app.Resources.MergedDictionaries` and `app.Styles`; second call is idempotent (`_isLoaded` guard—note static `_isLoaded` means a *second* `Application` instance in tests won't receive resources!).
  - `NumberField` horizontal drag scrubbing (`NumberField.cs:41-77`): left-pressing `PART_ValueButton` and moving pointer `+100px` in X increments `Value` by `1.0m` (`offset.X * 0.01`); when `Value` starts as `null`, `Convert.ToDecimal(null)` starts from `0m`; while `IsEditing == true`, drag is ignored.
  - Middle-click edit mode, `Enter` commit & `Escape` rollback (`NumberField.cs:111-124, 155-170`, `EditableSlider.cs:68-81, 97-111, 128-131`): middle-button release enters `IsEditing = true` and records `oldValue`; pressing `Escape` restores `oldValue` (`NumberField.Value = oldValue`; `EditableSlider` sets `InputValue.Text = oldValue.ToString()`, note culture sensitivity and missing `oldValue` capture in `EditableSlider.Button_OnPointerReleased` at `line 104`!); pressing `Enter` exits `IsEditing`.
  - Click-outside dismissal (`NumberField.cs:79-99, 126-153`, `EditableSlider.cs:36-56, 83-95, 113-126`): exiting `PART_TextBox` while `IsEditing` attaches `TopLevel` tunnel/bubble pointer handlers so clicking outside exits edit mode and marks `e.Handled = true`, while re-entering `PART_TextBox` removes the `TopLevel` handlers.
  - Template re-application (`NumberField.cs:11-39`, `EditableSlider.cs:10-31`): verify missing null-checks on `PART_ValueButton` / `PART_MainBorder` if a custom minimal template omits a part, and duplicate handler registration if `OnApplyTemplate` runs twice.
- **Test seam needed:** Add `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="VL.Avalonia.Tests" />` to `VL.Avalonia.Custom\src\VL.Avalonia.Custom.csproj` if inspecting internal state, and run under `Avalonia.Headless` with `ResourceLoader.IncludeCustomResources(Application.Current!)` inside a headless `Window` (`TopLevel`).

### 17. WinForms/Stride Key & Modifier Translation (`KeyUtils`, `KeyGesture`, `CursorNode`)
- **Priority:** Low | **Harness:** `Unit`
- **What it does:** `KeyUtils` (`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\KeyUtils.cs:9-758`) translates WinForms/VL `Keys`, `MouseButtons`, and `TouchNotificationKind` enums into Avalonia `Key`, `PhysicalKey`, `RawInputModifiers`, `RawPointerEventType`, and key symbols; `KeyGestureNodes` (`VL.Avalonia\src\Input\KeyGesture.cs:8-66`), `KeyGestureExtensions` (`KeyGestureExtensions.cs:6-13`), and `CursorNode` (`CursorNode.cs:8-35`) wrap Avalonia input gestures and cursors.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - Modifier stripping (`KeyUtils.cs:11-21, 77-80, 408-410`): `(Keys.C | Keys.Control | Keys.Shift)` produces `RawInputModifiers.Control | RawInputModifiers.Shift`, `ToKey() == Key.C`, and `ToPhysicalKey() == PhysicalKey.C`.
  - Suspicious missing generic modifier keys in `KeyUtils.ToKey` (`KeyUtils.cs:77-406` vs `469-483`): WinForms/Stride key events report `Keys.ShiftKey`, `Keys.ControlKey`, and `Keys.Menu` when pressing Shift/Ctrl/Alt—`ToPhysicalKey()` maps them to `ShiftLeft`/`ControlLeft`/`AltLeft`, but `ToKey()` omits all three (only handling `LShiftKey`/`RShiftKey`/`LControlKey`/`RControlKey`/`LMenu`/`RMenu`), returning `Key.None`!
  - `MouseButtons.ToEventType` (`KeyUtils.cs:39-60`): maps single buttons for `isUp = false/true`, and falls back to `RawPointerEventType.Move` when multiple mouse buttons are combined (`MouseButtons.Left | MouseButtons.Right`)—verify multi-button press/release behaviour!
  - `KeyGesture.Parse` & `ToKeyModifiers` (`KeyGesture.cs:8-65`, `KeyGestureExtensions.cs:8-12`): `"Ctrl+Shift+S"` parses and splits back into `(Key.S, KeyModifiers.Control | KeyModifiers.Shift)`; invalid gesture string throws `FormatException`; `RawInputModifiers` masks out mouse-button flags via `(KeyModifiers)(modifiers & RawInputModifiers.KeyboardMask)`.
- **Test seam needed:** `KeyUtils` is `internal static` in `VL.Avalonia.Skia`—covered once `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="VL.Avalonia.Tests" />` is added to `VL.Avalonia.Skia.csproj`.

  - `SkiaLayerControlWrapper.SetNotificationsSource` & `CallerInfoHook` (`SkiaMediaControls.cs:126-150, 215-218`, `CallerInfoHook.cs:32-57`): forwards `INotification` with `_callerInfo.Value ?? CallerInfo.Default` to `_layer`, unsubscribes when `notificationsSource` becomes `NoValue` or on `Dispose()` (note `SkiaLayerControlWrapper.Dispose` at `line 215` hides `ControlNodeBase.Dispose` instead of `override` and omits `base.Dispose()`!).

### 19. Gamma Dispatcher Clock/Timer & Runtime XAML Fluent Palette Loader (`GammaDispatcherImpl`, `FluentThemeHelper`)
- **Priority:** Low | **Harness:** `Unit` (`GammaDispatcherImpl`) / `Headless` (`FluentThemeHelper`)
- **What it does:** `GammaDispatcherImpl` (`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\GammaDispatcherImpl.cs:7-57`) implements Avalonia's `IDispatcherImpl` on top of VL's `IClock`, `SynchronizationContext`, and `System.Threading.Timer`; `FluentThemeHelper.LoadFluentEditorTheme` (`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\FluentThemeHelper.cs:9-74`) parses raw XAML `<FluentTheme>` snippets from the Fluent Theme Editor, injects missing XML namespaces, extracts `Light`/`Dark` `ColorPaletteResources`, and adds the configured `FluentTheme` to `Application.Styles`.
- **Concrete test cases:**
  - Suspicious 1-second clock truncation bug in `GammaDispatcherImpl.Now` (`GammaDispatcherImpl.cs:18`): `_clock.Time.Seconds` is a `double` (e.g., `1.750` seconds), and `(long)_clock.Time.Seconds * 1000` casts to `long` *before* multiplying by `1000`, returning `1000` instead of `1750`! Verify `Now` and `UpdateTimer(dueTimeInMs)` interval clamping (`lines 41-48`).
  - Thread affinity & signaling (`GammaDispatcherImpl.cs:20, 50-56`): `CurrentThreadIsLoopThread` is `true` only on `mainThread`; `Signal()` posts `Signaled` invocation through `SynchronizationContext.Post`.
  - `FluentThemeHelper.LoadFluentEditorTheme` (`FluentThemeHelper.cs:11-73`): parses `<FluentTheme>` both with and without `xmlns=` attributes, populates `fluentTheme.Palettes[ThemeVariant.Light]` and `[ThemeVariant.Dark]` while ignoring unknown `x:Key` values, and wraps malformed XML in `InvalidOperationException`.
- **Test seam needed:** `InternalsVisibleTo` on `VL.Avalonia.Skia.csproj` for `GammaDispatcherImpl` (`internal class`) with a fake `IClock` and recording `SynchronizationContext`; `Avalonia.Headless` for `FluentThemeHelper` (`AvaloniaRuntimeXamlLoader.Parse<ColorPaletteResources>`).

## Suspicious code found

The following likely bugs were identified while reading the codebase (none were modified):

1. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Animation\Easings.cs:18-105` (Confidence: High)** — Copy-paste bug across **18 out of 28 easing wrapper classes**: every `*EaseInOutWrapper` and `*EaseOutWrapper` (`Back`, `Bounce`, `Circular`, `Cubic`, `Elastic`, `Exponential`, `Quadratic`, `Quartic`, `Quintic`, `Sine`) inherits `EasingWrapperBase<*EaseIn>` instead of `<*EaseInOut>` / `<*EaseOut>`. Every `EaseOut` and `EaseInOut` node in VL actually evaluates `EaseIn`.
2. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Extensions\ColorExtensions.cs:33-34` (Confidence: High)** — `public static Color4 ToColor(this Color? color) => color.HasValue ? color.ToColor() : Color4.White;` calls `color.ToColor()` on `Color?` instead of `color.Value.ToColor()`, causing unconditional infinite recursion (`StackOverflowException`) whenever `color.HasValue` is `true`.
3. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Media\Effects.cs:83-101` (Confidence: High)** — `DropShadowDirectionEffectWrapper.SetDirection` checks `if (_direction.HasValue)` (the *previous* field value) before `_direction = direction;`. On the first call with a valid direction, `_direction.HasValue` is `false`, so it calls `ClearValue` instead of `SetValue` and then caches `_direction = direction` so subsequent frames with the same input also skip `SetValue`. Conversely, clearing the pin (`direction = NoValue`) enters the `if` branch and sets `0.0` instead of `ClearValue`.
4. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Styles\Styles.cs:151, 158, 381, 592, 607` (Confidence: High)** — Five style-setter process nodes (`SetRenderTransformOrigin`, `SetZIndex`, `SetBorderThickness`, `SetItemsSource<T>`, `SetDisplayMemberBinding`) inherit `StyleSetterBase<T>` instead of `StyleSetter<T>`. Because `StyleSetterBase<T>` (`StyleSetterBase.cs:24-58`) has no `SetValue` method, these 5 nodes have no value input pin and are complete no-ops.
5. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Buttons\SplitButtonNode.cs:45-60` (Confidence: High)** — `SplitButtonNodeBase` binds `[ImplementProperty]` to `Button.HotKeyProperty` and `Button.FlyoutProperty`. `SplitButton` derives from `ContentControl` (not `Button`) and defines its own `SplitButton.HotKeyProperty` and `SplitButton.FlyoutProperty` (cf. `SplitButtonExtensions.cs:38-58`), so the `Flyout` and `HotKey` pins on `SplitButton` and `ToggleSplitButton` never set the control's flyout or hotkey.
6. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Base\Control\ControlNodeBase.cs:168-175` (Confidence: High)** — `VisualNodeBase.SetRenderTransform` decomposes `Matrix` into `roll` (radians), converts it via `MathUtil.RadiansToDegrees(roll)`, and passes degrees into `TransformOperations.Builder.AppendRotate(double)`, which expects **radians** (compare `Styles.cs:135` and `TransformOperationsHelper.cs:20`). Control rotations via `RenderTransform` are 57.2958× too fast.
7. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Interactivity\RoutedEventListener.cs:127-130, 151-158, 172-186` (Confidence: High)** — `Resubscribe()` captures `var target = Input;` in its disposal closure (`line 94`) but references the mutable property `Event` (`target.RemoveHandler(Event, ...)` at `line 129`). Because `SetRoutedEvent` overwrites `Event` *before* calling `Resubscribe()`, changing from `EventA` to `EventB` removes `EventB` (leaking `EventA`), and changing `Event` to `null` (or an unresolved event name) throws `ArgumentNullException` inside `RemoveHandler`.
8. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\ChannelCommandBinding.cs:14, 21-27, 36-39` & `VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\CommandToChannel.cs:54-61` (Confidence: High)** — `ChannelCommandBindingBase<T>` leaks its constructor-created internal channel when `SetCommandChannel` replaces `_commandChannel`, and `Dispose()` disposes the caller's external `IChannel<T>`. Meanwhile `TChannelCommand<T>.CanExecute` (`CommandToChannel.cs:55`) throws `NotImplementedException()`.
9. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\BindingNameNode.cs:28-65` (Confidence: High)** — In `BindingNameAdvancedNode`, `ResolveProperty()` returns `false` without setting `_property = null` when `_input` becomes `null`, `_propertyName` becomes `null`/empty, or the new `_input` type does not register `_propertyName`. Switching `_input` from `TextBox` (`"Text"`) to `Border` causes `SetInput` (`BindingNode.cs:71-79`) to call `Bind()` with the stale `TextBox.TextProperty` on `Border`; setting `propertyName` to an invalid name leaves the old binding active.
10. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\BindingHelpers.cs:108-153` (Confidence: High)** — `SupprotedBindingInitialValueHandling.None` (`BindingNode.cs:17`) is never handled: `OneTime` (`lines 111-115`) falls into `else PushToProperty()`, and `OneWay`/`TwoWay` (`lines 136-138`) unconditionally prepend `.StartWith(channel.Value)`, overwriting the control's initial value even when `None` was selected.
11. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Data\TwoWayBinding.cs:28-37` & `VL.Avalonia\src\Data\OneWayBinding.cs:29-31` (Confidence: High)** — Fallback converters call `Convert.ChangeType(v, typeof(TProperty))` without `Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(...)` or `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture`, throwing `InvalidCastException` for any `Nullable<T>` type argument and making string↔number conversions culture-dependent.
12. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Base\Collections\SelectingItemsControlSelectedItemsHandler.cs:10, 21-45` & `TreeViewSelectedItemsHandler.cs:11, 21-43` (Confidence: High)** — Both classes declare `public virtual void Dispose()` without implementing `IDisposable`, so VL never disposes their `SelectionChanged` subscriptions; `SetInput` also fails to clear/sync `_output` when switching controls or disconnecting input.
13. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Menus\MenuItemNodeBase.cs:17-36`, `VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Inputs\AutoCompleteBox\AutoCompleteBoxNode.cs:183-191`, & `VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Flyouts\AttachedFlyout.cs:44-61` (Confidence: High)** — Resource/subscription leaks: `MenuItemNodeBase` never overrides `Dispose()` to dispose its 4 bindings (`_commandBinding`, `_isSelectedBinding`, `_isSubMenuOpenBinding`, `_isCheckedBinding`); `AutoCompleteBoxNodeBase.Dispose()` forgets `_isDropDownOpenBinding.Dispose()`; `AttachedFlyoutWrapper` discards the `IDisposable` from `_showAttachedFlyoutChannel.Subscribe(...)`.
14. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Animation\PageTransitions\CompositePageTransition.cs:20-39` (Confidence: High)** — `SetPageTransitions` checks `if (_pageTransitions != pageTransitions)` and updates `_output.PageTransitions`, but never assigns `_pageTransitions = pageTransitions;`, rebuilding a new `List<IPageTransition>` every frame.
15. **`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\GammaTopLevelImpl.cs:195-197, 257-260, 322-336` (Confidence: High)** — Input state bugs: (a) `MouseUp` uses XOR (`_inputModifiers ^= m.Buttons.ToModifier()`), which *sets* the mouse-button flag if `MouseDown` occurred outside the window; (b) `HandleKeyNotification` overwrites `_inputModifiers = keyCode.KeyData.ToModifier()`, wiping active mouse-button modifiers during key+drag; (c) `HandleTouchNotification` never removes cancelled touches from `_activeTouchIds`, permanently suppressing all mouse events (`if (_activeTouchIds.Count > 0) return true;`) after a touch cancel.
16. **`VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\GammaDispatcherImpl.cs:18` (Confidence: High)** — `public long Now => (long)_clock.Time.Seconds * 1000;` casts `double` seconds to `long` *before* multiplying by `1000`, quantizing Avalonia's dispatcher clock to whole 1000ms steps (`(long)(_clock.Time.Seconds * 1000)` was intended).
17. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Skia\SkiaMediaDrawingOperationBase.cs:61-83` (Confidence: High)** — `SkiaImageDrawingOperation.Render` calls `canvas.Save()` at line 61 and returns early at line 66 (`if (Image.IsDisposed()) return;`) without calling `canvas.Restore()`.
18. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Helpers\ReparentingHelper.cs:44-46` (Confidence: High)** — `case ItemsControl itemsControl: itemsControl.Items.Remove(control);` throws `InvalidOperationException` when `itemsControl.ItemsSource` is active.
19. **`VL.Avalonia.CodeGen\AvaloniaSourceGenerator.cs:113-115` & `AvaloniaReflectionGenerator.cs:29` (Confidence: Medium-High)** — `context.AddSource($"{classSymbol.Name}.g.cs", ...)` omits generic arity and namespace, colliding if two partial `[ProcessNode]` classes share `Name`; `AvaloniaReflectionGenerator.Initialize` wraps registration in an empty `catch (Exception) { }`.
20. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Controls\Base\AttachedProperty\AttachedPropertyBase.cs:12-20`, `GridAttachedProperties.cs:41`, & `ToolTip.cs:33-48` (Confidence: Medium-High)** — Changing `_input` from one control to another leaves old attached properties set on the previous control; passing `new Optional<Control>(null!)` throws `NullReferenceException` on `_input.Value.ClearValue(...)`.
21. **`VL.Avalonia\src\Styles\StyleSetterBase.cs:125-291` & `VL.Avalonia.Skia\src\KeyUtils.cs:77-406` (Confidence: Medium)** — Multi-pin style setters (`StyleSetterSRT`, `StyleSetterThickness*`, `StyleSetterCornerRadius*`) emit `Thickness(0)` / `CornerRadius(0)` / identity transform instead of `NoValue` when all pins are disconnected; `KeyUtils.ToKey` omits generic `Keys.ShiftKey`, `Keys.ControlKey`, and `Keys.Menu`, mapping Shift/Ctrl/Alt presses to `Key.None`.

## Skipped

The following areas were reviewed and deliberately skipped because they are thin pass-through wrappers over Avalonia properties/constructors already covered by Avalonia's own test suite:

- **Generated & Pass-Through Extension Methods (`*Extensions.cs`):** All fluent `Set*` extension files (`ButtonExtensions.cs`, `MenuExtensions.cs`, `MenuItemExtensions.cs`, `ContextMenuExtensions.cs`, `FlyoutBaseExtensions.cs`, `PopupFlyoutBaseExtensions.cs`, `MenuFlyoutExtensions.cs`, `SplitButtonExtensions.cs`) that only call `SetValue`/`ClearValue`.
- **Thin `[ImplementProperty]` Control Wrappers:** Simple control nodes with no custom state, conversions, or subscriptions—such as `Border`, `Viewbox`, `Decorator`, `Expander`, `StackPanel`, `WrapPanel`, `DockPanel`, `UniformGrid`, `Canvas`, `RelativePanel`, `FlexPanelNode`, `TextBlock`, `Label`, `SelectableTextBlock`, `MaskedTextBox`, `Calendar`, `CalendarDatePicker`, `ProgressBar`, `ButtonSpinner`, `RepeatButton`, `FlyoutNodes`, `Separator`, `PathIcon`, `Shapes` (`Rectangle`, `Ellipse`, `Line`, `Path`, `Polygon`, `Polyline`), `ScrollViewer` (beyond `TwoWayBinding` covered in Candidate #2), and `TabControl` (beyond `SelectingItemsControlNodeBase` covered in `ItemsSourceSync` / Candidate #11).
- **Thin Media & Brush Property Wrappers:** `BrushWrapperBase`, `SolidColorBrush`, `LinearGradientBrush`, `RadialGradientBrush`, `ConicGradientBrush`, `TileBrushWrapperBase`, `GradientStop`, `CombinedGeometry`, `EllipseGeometry`, `LineGeometry`, `RectangleGeometry`, `GeometryGroup`, `Transitions.cs` concrete subclasses, `PageSlideBaseWrapper`, `TextDecoration`, and `Custom\Controls\Value\Color*Wrapper.cs` (`ColorPickerWrapper`, `ColorViewWrapper`, `ColorSliderWrapper`, `ColorSpectrumWrapper`, `ColorPreviewerWrapper`, `TemplatedSlider`).
- **Boilerplate Platform Wiring & Empty Projects:** `VL.Avalonia.Stride\src\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs`, `VL.Avalonia\src\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs`, `Sandbox` patches/files, and thin WinForms/clipboard/cursor/settings forwarding stubs in `VL.Avalonia.Skia` (`PointUtils.cs`, `GammaRenderTimer.cs`, `GammaPlatformSettings.cs`, `GammaPlatformClipboard.cs`, `GammaDevices.cs`).
